cards.b: Kava Lend suffered a hack resulting in a loss of roughly $3.8 million, causing the KAVA token to drop nearly 40%. Approximately 49.2 million KAVA was bridged to BNB Chain via LayerZero and sold for about $2.1 million in BNB and USDT.

per.KAVA: Dropped nearly 40% following a $3.8 million exploit and subsequent token sell-off.
